Description: {{TAG|SDFTD3_DAMPING}} sets the type of damping function in the DFT-D3 method implemented in the [[simple-DFT-D3]] package.
----
{{TAG|SDFTD3_DAMPING}} allows to set the type of damping function to be used in the DFT-D3 method implemented in the [[simple-DFT-D3]] package ({{TAG|IVDW}}=15). The available damping functions are {{TAG|SDFTD3_DAMPING}}=zero,{{cite|grimme:jcp:10}} rational,{{cite|grimme:jcc:11}} mzero,{{cite|smith:jpcl:2016}} mrational,{{cite|smith:jpcl:2016}} and optimizedpower.{{cite|witte:jctc:2017}}
{{NB|mind|
*The {{TAG|SDFTD3_DAMPING}} tag is available from VASP.6.6.0 onwards.
*The {{TAG|SDFTD3_DAMPING}} can be used only for the [[simple-DFT-D3]] package ({{TAG|IVDW}}{{=}}15).}}
